- Research topics: Interactive RL; Learning from Human Feedback; Learning from Demonstrations; Human modeling for robot learning; Evaluation & datasets for HRI; HRI; RLHF/RLAIF; IntRL; Preference learning; Human factors
- Open to: research collaborations in HRI, RLHF for robots, and human data collection methodology.
